draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact EXACTLY as given, canonicalize it as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, and persist the exact bytes hashed as proposal_canon.json in the run scratch dir; compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json) and then compute seed = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) (salt as provided by the instance). A third party re-derives by hashing the same canonical proposal_canon.json to reproduce hProposal, then hashing hProposal concatenated with the same salt to reproduce seedHex; the check is mechanical: sha256sum proposal_canon.json must equal hProposal, and sha256sum of (hProposal + salt) must equal seedHex.
